name: enbw
setup: wh = hamming(8); whann = hann(64); wrect = rectwin(64); wblack = blackman(64); wh64 = hamming(64);
expr: b_h = enbw(wh); b_hann = enbw(whann); b_rect = enbw(wrect); b_black = enbw(wblack); b_fs = enbw(wh64, 100); b_fs2 = enbw(wh, 2); b_rect8 = enbw(rectwin(8));
comment: Sig: bw = enbw(window[, fs]). Equivalent noise bandwidth: N · Σ(w²) / (Σw)². With fs, scales output by fs/N. tol=1e-12. Specs covers hamming/hann/rectwin/blackman + fs-scaled forms.
